scene: Evening living room. Mom sits on the sofa at screen-left; Child sits on the rug at screen-right, facing her with hands in his lap. Locked 16:9 medium two-shot with both faces visible.

emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline. Both speak at a normal family volume with small, natural facial movements and gestures.
emotion.allowed_shift: Child shares his news with a lively but calm voice and small gestures; Mom listens with warm interest and one soft laugh.
emotion.forbidden: No exaggerated surprise, wide-eyed shock, bouncing, raised voices, impatience, blaming or teasing. Any disappointment, worry or sadness stays mild and brief, and the adult helps things stay steady.

clips.end: Both relax; Child's hands return to his lap.
